title: What If a Probe Reached Another Star in 20 Years?

scenes.text: What if a spacecraft reached another star in 20 years? One real plan says it could.
Breakthrough Starshot would fire a giant laser at sails only a few hundred atoms thick.
Each probe would be a gram-scale chip. A fleet could number about a thousand.
The beam would push them to 20 percent of light speed, around 100 million miles an hour.
They would cross four light-years in about 20 years. Today's fastest spacecraft would need around 30,000.
The catch: it needs a laser near 100 gigawatts and about 10 billion dollars. For now, it exists only on paper.

description:
What if a probe could reach Alpha Centauri in 20 years?
Breakthrough Starshot proposes laser-pushed sails at 20 percent of light speed, but it is still only a plan.
What should we run through next?
